question: When can a local observation or case become reusable knowledge consumed by another task?
procedure: Keep observed facts, inferred meaning and proposed application in separate fields and statuses.
Review the source-page roles, cross-page conflicts, suitableFor, notFor and the proposed DangoUI consumer.
Approve only the narrowest evidenced scope, with reviewer, decision reference and source version; otherwise retain candidate or reject it.
After rendered application and independent QA, promote the tested recipe or record a negative regression; user visual rejection overrides protocol PASS.
When a source or judgment changes, version the record and revalidate only dependent consumers.
notFor: Silent approval from a validator PASS
Treating a URL or color frequency as semantic proof
readerPurpose: 执行判断的步骤与取舍
